long_description:
Drama Drama is building the monetization platform for AI character and drama creators.

Creators are already building AI characters and serialized stories that attract audiences on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and other social platforms, but turning that fandom into direct revenue is still difficult.

Drama Drama lets creators monetize their existing characters and series through gated episodes, paid AI character chat across text, voice and video, personalized fan experiences and other direct-to-fan products.

Creators can bring the content and audience they already have. For selected creators who want help producing a series, we also offer optional co-production.
name: Drama Drama
one_liner: Monetization platform for AI characters and dramas
